findings.title: [P1] Keep branch names out of the shell command
findings.body: When `branch` is caller-controlled, shell metacharacters are interpreted because `exec()` invokes a shell; for example, a value like `missing; <command>` runs the appended command with the process's privileges. The prior `execFile("git", ["show", branch])` call passed the same value as a literal argument, so this is a command-injection regression. Keep using `execFile` (or otherwise avoid shell parsing).
